chunks: Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl, from al-Faḍl ibn Shādhān, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ribʿī ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, concerning the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
And if they had upheld the Torah and the Evangel and what was sent down to them from their Lord.

key_terms.أُنْزِلَ: was sent down or revealed by Allah
key_terms.التَّوْرَاةَ: the Torah, the scripture given before the Gospel
key_terms.الْإِنْجِيلَ: the Evangel, the scripture given to ʿĪsā عليه السلام
key_terms.الْوَلَايَةُ: the wilayah, divinely ordained authority and guardianship
key_terms.رَبِّهِمْ: their Lord, the divine source of revelation

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام interpret “what was sent down to them from their Lord” in Qur'an 5:66?
ai.summary: Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام explains this Qur'anic phrase by identifying “what was sent down to them from their Lord” as the wilayah. The report presents wilayah as a central revealed matter tied to properly upholding divine guidance.
